Korea Investment Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.83% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Korea Investment Corp bought 77,400 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 4.30 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $727.43 million, up from 4.22 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Korea Investment Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $840.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 4.10% or $7.08 during the last trading session, reaching $165.72. About 60.26 million shares traded or 56.69% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Korea Investment Corp, which manages about $21.97 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Applied Matls Inc (NASDAQ:AMAT) by 545,800 shares to 2.00 million shares, valued at $102.13M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Western Digital Corp (NASDAQ:WDC) by 490,400 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 126,649 shares, and cut its stake in Netflix Inc (NASDAQ:NFLX). Apple Inc.
